method: Additive skinned eyelid curtains fitted to raycast face surface. Painted eye geometry remains static beneath them. Sampling excludes disconnected hair islands and excessive front depth, using the 448-triangle actual eye-landmark connected face patch.

face_blink.reason: Bilateral skin-coverage channels, neutral return, Blender sampled closure, FBX serialization and Unity numerical/runtime control verified. Full eyelid contact and unobscured bilateral Unity closure/art review are not passed. Right half-closure has 5 sampled vertices up to 0.286795mm behind skin.

face_gaze.reason: C2 real-eyeball reconstruction rejected; C3 retains original fixed painted eyes

face_jaw.reason: Source lips form a closed fused shell without established oral cavity; three basic face candidates spent on blink/gaze. No claim that topology repair is impossible.

adoption_scope: Experimental blink geometry only; not whole-face quality or canonical player approval.

unity.scope: Integrated_B1_C3 actual Play + LAB_B1_Idle; five channel values, neutral return and no Animator overwrite per Unity agent. Art/complete closure remain limited.
